verdict.rationale: Conductor documents pieces of a debug loop: workspaces created from a GitHub or Linear issue, a per-task terminal and diff, agents that can test repositories and run builds, failing-check logs, and checkpoints to revert code and chat state. It does not document a reproduce, root-cause, verify workflow as a capability, and the actual diagnosis relies on the third-party agents it orchestrates. Missing for 10: documented issue-reproduction workflow, root-cause narrowing or debugging tooling, explicit fix-verification flow, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: create a workspace from a branch, pull request, GitHub issue, or Linear issue
The agent can test your repositories, update install and setup scripts, and run builds
PR comments and failing-check logs now load while a cloud workspace is asleep.
Revert code and chat state to an earlier turn
Each task gets its own workspace, branch, files, terminal, diff, and review path.
